proposal: Insert a TPS2141/TPS2151 switch before the retained D1, and drive RT6150 EN directly from SW_PG
scope: Datasheet-envelope compatibility screen for one hypothetical wiring proposal; no component or native-board change and no USB compliance verdict.

settledLoadSupportDuringLowMode.implication: Do not leave the full assumed workload enabled during low-current startup. This comparison does not specify the actual startup workload.

directPowerGoodToEnable.headerCompatibility: Existing 3V3_EN permits an external pull-down; a push-pull PG output is not an equivalent open-drain source.
directPowerGoodToEnable.externalVsysCompatibility: A VBUS-powered PG signal alone does not provide the existing external-VSYS-only enable behavior.

handoverOrdering.implication: Typical delayed PG waveforms are not a guaranteed minimum delay. Coordinated startup needs independent timing or rail-readiness evidence.

outputCharging.implication: Enabling the converter after handover still requires analysis of C21, distributed rail capacitance and startup load.

decision: Do not adopt this direct-wiring proposal. Keep the board unchanged while designing an explicit complete startup sequence.
